text:
### Compensation Guidelines  
| Issue Severity | Compensation Range |
|---|---|
| Minor (inconvenience, slow response) | £20–£50 |
| Moderate (financial loss <£100, service failure) | £50–£150 |
| Significant (financial loss £100–£500, multiple failures) | £150–£300 |
| Major (financial loss >£500, serious service failure) | £300+ (per FOS guidance) |

raw_entities.description: A tiered compensation framework that categorizes customer issues by severity and financial impact, determining appropriate compensation ranges from £20 to £300+ based on the nature and extent of the service failure or financial loss incurred.
context: Major (financial loss >£500, serious service failure) | £300+ (per FOS guidance)

raw_entities.name: Issue Severity Classification
raw_entities.description: The step of evaluating and categorizing a customer complaint or service failure into one of four severity tiers: Minor, Moderate, Significant, or Major, based on the nature of inconvenience, financial loss, and service impact.

raw_entities.name: Compensation Level Determination
raw_entities.description: A branching decision point that routes compensation decisions based on the classified severity level of the issue, with each severity tier triggering a specific compensation range outcome.
context: Major (financial loss >£500, serious service failure) | £300+ (per FOS guidance)
